items.title: Live: 'It's not fair': Browning slams 100m heat format, O'Callaghan drops out of 50 back
items.description: It's day four of the Commonwealth Games and that means the athletics program starts, marking the first of three days that feature swimming as well as track and field. Follow live.

items.title: Previously unheard from survivors detail horrific abuse at Christian Brothers
items.description: As victims of child sexual abuse at the hands of Christian Brothers await compensation, they accuse those involved of stalling on payouts and abusing them all over again.

items.title: Australia's most disaster-hit state to opt out of AusAlert as government hails national test a success
items.description: The AusAlert system was tested today, with millions of devices receiving alerts, but many Australians reported issues and delays.

items.title: Food fraud investigation reveals the disturbing truth behind the labels
items.description: A Four Corners investigation has uncovered products whose labels did not match independent scientific testing, raising serious questions about the integrity of Australia's food supply.

items.title: Bodies of woman and toddler recovered from ocean in SA's South East
items.description: The bodies of a woman and her toddler have been recovered from the ocean in South Australia's South East, where emergency services are continuing to search for another child, police say.

items.title: Leadership contest could leave Victorian Labor in 'nightmare scenario'
items.description: Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan's leadership is on a knife's edge, with Labor MPs moving to replace her in spill tomorrow. Here's how the challenge could play out.

items.title: Hanson 'disappointed' after losing racial discrimination appeal
items.description: One Nation leader Pauline Hanson loses an appeal against a court ruling which found she racially discriminated against Greens senator Mehreen Faruqi.

items.title: Risk consultant defends arming private security at Jewish events
items.description: A royal commission on antisemitism has pressed a risk and security consultant on his belief that the private security sector should be armed when protecting open air events.

items.title: Fugitive developer sought influence via ex-premier's brothers, ICAC told
items.description: The corruption watchdog has heard that fugitive developer Jean Nassif allegedly sought to use former NSW premier Dominic Perrottet's brothers to influence government decisions.

items.title: Chinese national arrested at airport after alleged $20,000 bribe
items.description: A Chinese national has been extradited to Queensland over an alleged attempt to bribe a public official with a bag of tea containing $20,000 in cash.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
